integrity.proof_scope: all integer star sizes and all real positive trust at most one
integrity.verification_method: independently assembled labelled exact rational stationary moment systems plus symbolic factorization

scientific_limitations: One-sided random-neighbor averaging on an unweighted star with equal receiving-agent trust and equal activation rates.
At least one stubborn leaf of each of exactly two distinct opinion values, and at least two flexible leaves.
Only stationary ensemble covariance, not time-lag covariance, causal effects, field measurements or arbitrary graphs.
title: A sharp trust threshold for cofluctuation on opinion stars
